meta.datePolicy: Overview: actual local today inclusive, previous 6 days; future dates excluded. Analytics: selected date and period.
notes: All values are fictional portfolio demonstration data.
Dates after actual today are pre-generated future samples, not observed events.
Daily users.total is a cumulative snapshot; daily requests.total is a daily count.
tokens.cached is included within tokens.input; do not add cached again to total.
costs.cached is included within costs.input; do not add cached again to costs.total.
byHour is hourly request count in local time; sum equals daily requests.total.
Model/project allocation sums match daily requests.total; project costs may differ by minor rounding.
Logs are 276 sample events, not the full request ledger.
